tested_effect: timing-specific 2024-2025 MDD and 5pct expected-shortfall improvement versus matched-validity v1254
statistic: minimum across three scenarios of MDD_reduction/20pct and tail_loss_reduction/15pct
pass_rule: Observed statistic must be at least 1 and strictly above both family-wise 95th-percentile thresholds.
interpretation_boundary: Passing validates risk timing only; the frozen 15pct historical gate and cumulative Bonferroni gate remain separate and failed.
